summary: Dalian Jafeng Automation Co., Ltd is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, specializing in the development and production of die bonding and attach equipment. The company serves both domestic and international markets, offering advanced solutions tailored to the semiconductor industry's evolving needs.
